changes: Deep sweep of all nine Catapults: about 50 programmes added, covering programme, priorities, services and funding pages as well as news.
Closing soon: Energy Resilience Accelerator (Energy Systems) closes 8 Nov 2026, with trial funding up to about £40k.

Connected Places: eleven running or just-closed programmes added, including Freight Innovation Fund, TRIG, Scale-Up Support, Diesel-Free Sites and Clean Transport Accelerator: Maritime; SME Network confirmed still always open on its own page.
Digital Catapult: Applied AI Growth Programme sprints (rolling), Assured 5G, Quantum Access Cohort 3, Black Founders, SONIC Labs and others added.
Offshore Renewable Energy: NEOWIND fund, F4OR rounds, OWGP and FLOWB added. High Value Manufacturing: Wind Innovation Hub (closed 5 Oct) and the industrial AI pilot found.
Energy Systems: Retrofit Accelerator cohort 1 confirmed (eight SMEs, Mar–Jul 2026) and incubation, Living Lab and SME consultation routes added.

Also new: Microgravity Biopharma Accelerator and NADIC drone test-bed (Satellite Applications); PACE, direct investment and KTPs (Medicines Discovery); in-kind spin-out support (Cell and Gene Therapy).

openRolling.name: Freight and Logistics Innovation Network (FLIN)
openRolling.desc: National network that helps freight and logistics innovations reach market by reducing adoption risk.

openRolling.name: SME Network
openRolling.desc: Membership route for SMEs with transport and place innovations; feeds into CPC calls and pilots.
openRolling.note: Missing from the CPC open-calls list on 26 Oct, but its own page (updated 2 Jul 2026) still says always open. Judged case by case on fit and TRL.

openRolling.name: West Midlands Logistics & Distribution Cluster
openRolling.desc: Free membership for UK-registered organisations in or interested in logistics and distribution in the West Midlands; run with the West Midlands Combined Authority.

openRolling.name: UK Microgravity Demonstration Programme
openRolling.desc: Support for 2–3 ISS microgravity demonstration projects at roughly 15–30% intervention, across life sciences, materials, semiconductors, manufacturing and defence.
openRolling.note: Applicant webinar 29 Oct; clarification questions by 5 Nov. Shortlisting Jan–Mar 2027; indicative flight summer 2027 onwards.

openRolling.name: HMGCC Co-Creation Challenges
openRolling.desc: Four HMGCC challenges listed: hidden stab vests for women, AI-enhanced x-ray imaging for bomb disposal, smart glasses for mapping and multi-terrain micro robotic systems.
openRolling.note: Challenge-led contracts rather than a cohort accelerator. Deadlines match the Connected Places listings for the three that CPC also lists.

openRolling.name: Innovate UK Business Growth
openRolling.desc: Growth support for established, innovation-driven SMEs: a dedicated growth specialist plus access to IP expertise, investor networks and international partners.
openRolling.note: Promoted by the Catapult, delivered by Innovate UK. Not described as a cohort accelerator.

openRolling.name: Space Enterprise Lab network
openRolling.desc: Free collaborative workspace for project delivery at 15 sites, including Harwell, Westcott, IDEALondon, Edinburgh, Glasgow, Belfast and Newport. Book through an enquiry form.

openRolling.name: Applied AI Growth Programme: Sprints
openRolling.desc: Sprints for UK AI businesses moving from validated pilots to deployment-ready, across six growth sectors. Demonstrator/testbed and ecosystem streams are still being designed.
openRolling.note: Funded by Innovate UK. Workshop series: 18 Nov London, 25 Nov Manchester, 19 and 27 Jan 2027, by expression of interest.

openRolling.name: Energy Start-up Incubation & Acceleration
openRolling.desc: Needs assessment, mentoring, and introductions to customers and investors for high-growth-potential energy start-ups. Enquire through a form on the page.

openRolling.name: Living Lab and Whole Energy Systems Accelerator (WESA)
openRolling.desc: Test-bed of over 5,000 UK homes, plus WESA, which links Living Lab homes to network emulation. Free virtual consultation by email.
openRolling.note: Enrolment terms and WESA trial availability not stated.

openRolling.name: Free SME growth consultation
openRolling.desc: Booking is open for a free growth consultation with the Catapult's innovator team.

openRolling.name: In-kind support for academic spin-outs and start-ups
openRolling.desc: In-kind Catapult support for company creation and early translation of therapeutics, platforms and enabling technologies. Open to academic researchers at UK universities.
openRolling.note: Also: a free GMP feasibility clinic and digital/automation testbeds, both by enquiry.

openRolling.name: Start-up and entrepreneur advisory service
openRolling.desc: Free three-step support (consultation, discovery workshop, innovation project) for early manufacturing businesses. Not suited to the very earliest stage.
openRolling.note: Page last edited Jan 2025. Also lists centre schemes (NCC Edge, MTC Reach, Manufacturing Energy Toolkit) with no stated terms.

openRolling.name: Knowledge Transfer Partnerships (MDC as Knowledge Base)
openRolling.desc: A graduate KTP Associate employed by MDC is placed in a UK company for 12–36 months; Innovate UK typically funds two-thirds of SME project cost.
openRolling.note: Deadlines sit on Innovate UK's KTP rounds page. UK Intracellular Drug Delivery Centre (CPI-led, with MDC) also offers a single access point for RNA and delivery innovators.

openRolling.name: Offshore Wind Growth Partnership (OWGP)
openRolling.desc: Industry-funded support for offshore wind supply chain firms, delivered by the Catapult for the Offshore Wind Industry Council; £100m over 10 years with competitive rounds.

openRolling.name: Business Connect scheme
openRolling.desc: Access to the Catapult's expertise and facilities for start-ups and SMEs, mentioned on its start-ups page.
openRolling.note: No eligibility, dates or link given. Unconfirmed.

gaps: 26 Oct deep sweep: one research agent per Catapult read programme, priorities, services, funding, news and event pages. Summaries from the page fetcher can miss form deadlines, so confirm key dates on the source page before applying.

Not reached: the Crick KQ Labs application page and the PACE funding page (permission timeouts), the MTC Scale-Up Accelerator page, the ORE Open Opportunities list (script-loaded), Digital Catapult programme listing pages 2 and 3, and the Skipso and Simply Do application portals.
Several Connected Places pages are labelled 'Closed' while their text still shows a future deadline, and some Launch Academy pages are stale. Entries use the dated text where it is clear.

Partner-run and funder items are included where a Catapult hosts or delivers them. Innovate UK Investor Partnerships (ACT and Semiconductors) is not listed: its closing date was not found and results were due 16 Nov 2026.
Researchers in Residence (academic residency, Connected Places and Satellite Applications) and skills programmes are excluded as not accelerator-type. No BSGN accelerator activity was found.
